description: This file defines API interaction functions for a React frontend, including fetching product data, fetching individual product details, creating orders, and fetching user orders. It includes mock data fallbacks for offline or backend-unavailable scenarios.

methods.name: fetchProducts
methods.description: Retrieves a list of products from the backend, with fallback to mock data if backend is unavailable.

methods.name: fetchProductById
methods.description: Fetches details of a specific product by its ID, with fallback to mock data.

methods.name: createOrder
methods.description: Sends a new order to the backend, or returns a placeholder object if backend is unavailable.

methods.name: fetchOrders
methods.description: Retrieves user orders, with mock data fallback if backend is unavailable.
